reviewScope: Fresh internal source-guided review of all 142 taxa and both optical variants. measurementMethod: Adaptive Bezier flattening in scripts/geometry.mjs. Blade bounds exclude petioles and stroke widths. Width and height are axis-aligned viewBox extents; for oblique compound leaflets their ratio is not the biological leaflet length-to-width ratio. No physical scale is implied.
